title: [Suggestion] Reachlock
body:
### Resource Name
Reachlock

### URL
https://github.com/shaneraphel/aletheia-reachlock

### GitHub Repository
shaneraphel/aletheia-reachlock

### Category
Inverse Kinematics

### Description
Two-link inverse kinematics and integer disk clearance. Unreachable is a refusal. Empty field is absence. Same pose and disks hash to the same digest.

### Why should it be included?
It names two cases that sit next to IK and collision libraries: an unreachable target is a raise, not a rest pose; an empty clearance field is absence, not a touching zero. The clearance compare is integer `r²`, so a field can be cited by hash.

### Must-have checklist
- [x] Relevant to robotics
- [x] Publicly accessible (MIT)
- [x] Not a duplicate of an existing entry
- [x] Has a meaningful description

### Scoring checklist
- [ ] Popularity: ≥ 50 GitHub stars
- [x] Activity: commit within the last 2 years
- [x] Documentation: README with run and verify commands
- [ ] Maturity: ≥ 6 months old
- [x] Uniqueness: integer-hashable disk clearance plus unreachable-as-refusal

Per CONTRIBUTING, this is a suggestion issue. A direct resource PR would be closed automatically. Scoring is 3/5 if uniqueness is counted; popularity and maturity are not claimed.
